title: tx_queue.c: Unchecked pthread_mutex_init return value
description:
Line 217-218: pthread_mutex_init() return value is not checked. If initialization fails (ENOMEM/EAGAIN), tx_queue_init returns 0 (success) but the mutex is in an undefined state. Subsequent lock_queue/unlock_queue calls will use an uninitialized mutex, leading to undefined behavior. While pthread_mutex_init rarely fails, this violates defensive programming for security-critical locking code.
